1.consolidated_definition: "Ampolla": objeto cilíndrico con cuello estrecho, generalmente de vidrio o plástico, utilizado para contener líquidos o gases.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Bottle: cylindrical object with a narrow neck, typically made of glass or plastic, used to contain liquids or gases.
